scope: Rename filename flicker while holding the mouse button and dragging a text selection

expected_failures: Repeated native redraw toggles during drag
Repeated native child visibility losses during drag
Mouse capture remains held after a move without MK_LBUTTON
Queued filter Escape WM_CHAR reaches the native default path
Queued filter Enter WM_CHAR reaches the native default path

fixture.method: Baseline and preliminary runs privately compile the three relevant production translation units. The final --unified run compiles only probe.cpp privately and links every production object from the completed pulse build, installs production hosted RenameEditProc/FilterEditProc, and exercises local window messages against native EDIT and production LumaText rendering.
fixture.native_observer: A subclass below the production subclass counts native EM_SETSEL, WM_SETREDRAW, WS_VISIBLE losses and queued control characters. It consumes forwarded Enter/Escape only at the bottom to avoid deliberately playing the old error beep.
fixture.environment: Offscreen visible nonactivating owner, 220x30 rename edit, 194-character filename, light theme, 100 percent scale; LumaText enabled.
fixture.side_effects: Isolated AppState with persistence disabled; no real file operation, user preference change or global input injection.

changes.before: Each ApplyMouseSelection sends a live EM_SETSEL; DefPresentedChildEditProc surrounds each native selection update with WM_SETREDRAW FALSE/TRUE. Native EDIT removes WS_VISIBLE on FALSE, producing repeated observable surface visibility churn.
changes.fix: Use one native redraw-suppression transaction for the captured mouse selection while retaining WS_VISIBLE. Continue updating the native selection on every drag move, and present once through the outer mouse handler. End the transaction on mouse-up, capture loss, buttonless move or presentation fallback; preserve externally hidden state and remove the property on destruction.
changes.compatibility: No deferred native selection, struct layout change or ABI change. edit_host.h adds two helper function declarations. Prior F18 viewport retention is preserved.
checks: Every drag move updates native selection; forward and backward movement cross the anchor
No redraw toggles or visibility loss during the 16 captured drag moves
Production LumaText paints the selection while held and after release
Mouse-up retains native selection and releases capture
Native WM_CHAR keyboard editing works while mouse capture is held
Capture loss and a move without MK_LBUTTON clear the transaction
Repeated same-point long-name clicks preserve the F18 viewport
Capture cleanup preserves an externally hidden editor
Destroying a captured editor safely clears capture

changes.before: FilterEditProc consumes Enter/Escape WM_KEYDOWN and closes the editor, but the already queued WM_CHAR falls through to the native EDIT default handler.
changes.fix: Consume Enter/Escape WM_CHAR immediately while retaining ordinary character editing and filter synchronization.
checks: Production filter Escape closes the editor and its queued WM_CHAR never reaches the native default path
Production filter Enter closes the editor and its queued WM_CHAR never reaches the native default path

visuals.preliminary_review: Both 220x30 production-rendered captures were visually inspected: blue selection remains visible and the long filename ending is rendered.
visuals.final_review: Both final 220x30 production-rendered held/released captures were inspected: blue selection remains visible and the long filename ending is rendered.

limits: The flicker evidence measures child surface visibility churn; no physical display flicker video was recorded.
Local synthetic window messages exercise real production handlers, native EDIT and LumaText; no physical mouse drag or physical Ctrl+F sequence was injected.
Native keyboard editing during capture was verified; real IME composition and accessibility client interaction were not exercised.
The beep path is verified by preventing queued WM_CHAR from reaching the native default sink; actual system audio was not played or listened to.
No full regression suite, installed copy replacement or actual rename operation was performed.

after.linked_production_objects: All pulse production objects from the completed unified build; only probe.cpp is compiled privately in final --unified mode.

subsequent_index_build_note: Parent announced a later index-cache boundary correction and index library/pulse relink, outside this UI package. This record identifies the exact UI verification executable and editor objects; it does not claim that later index rebuild was exercised by the UI fixture.
